head: MYTH:
*YOU NEED $76,000*
*FOR BITCOIN*
scenes.say: Myth: you need seventy six thousand dollars to own Bitcoin. Wrong.

head: FACT:
*1 BTC =*
~100 MILLION SATS~
scenes.say: One Bitcoin splits into a hundred million tiny units, called sats.

head: *~13,000 SATS*
scenes.say: At today's price, ten dollars is about thirteen thousand sats.

head: 21 MILLION
*MAX SUPPLY*
scenes.say: The price looks huge because only twenty one million coins will ever exist.

head: DID YOU KNOW?
*✅ YES / ❌ NO*

scenes.say: So, one whole coin, or a few sats? Not financial advice, just data.
